stemMd: A machine transfers 3600 J of useful energy in 30 s. What is its average useful power?
explanationMd: Average power is energy transferred per time. Divide 3600 joules by 30 seconds to get 120 joules per second, or watts.

distractorRationale.b: This treats energy as power without a time interval.
distractorRationale.c: This multiplies energy by time instead of dividing.
